description: This file defines an enumeration class VoiceWakeMode used for specifying different voice wake modes, including Off, Foreground, and Always, with a companion object providing a method to parse these modes from raw string values.

classes.name: VoiceWakeMode
classes.description: An enum class representing different voice wake modes with associated raw string values and a companion object for parsing.

methods.name: fromRawValue
methods.description: Parses a raw string value to return the corresponding VoiceWakeMode enum, defaulting to Foreground if no match is found.
